title: How to Choose an Indian Fashion Designer Online
metaTitle: How to Choose an Indian Fashion Designer Online | Label Swathy Reddy
metaDescription: Looking for an Indian fashion designer online? Learn what to check before you order: design style, fabrics, fit, reviews and delivery.
excerpt: Choosing an Indian fashion designer online is different from walking into a store. You cannot touch the fabric or try the fit, so trust matters more.

content.text: Choosing an Indian fashion designer online is different from walking into a store. You cannot touch the fabric or try the fit, so trust matters more. Here is what to look for when selecting a boutique to craft your dream ensemble.

A good designer label has a recognisable signature: a silhouette, a colour story, a way of handling detailing. Browse the collections and ask yourself whether you can tell the work apart from others. That is the sign of a real designer label rather than a catalogue of trends.

Look for clear photos from the front, back and close-up, along with fabric names, prices and care instructions. If a label hides these, expect surprises later. Authentic boutiques share the exact weave, zari grade, and handcrafting methods.
The best online designers offer a size guide, a measurement form and a consultation. This matters most for custom and made-to-order outfits where every contour must drape effortlessly.
Social proof is the closest thing to a fitting room. Check Instagram tags, client testimonials and candid customer photos across festive events and real weddings.
Shipping destinations, delivery timeline estimates, custom-order lead times and return policies should be easy to find and transparent from day one.

content.title: Why customers choose Label Swathy Reddy
content.text: Label Swathy Reddy is a designer label built around contemporary design, thoughtful detailing and personal service. Whether you are in Hyderabad, elsewhere in India or abroad, you can explore the collections and connect directly with our design team.

faqs.answer: We provide transparent fabric specifications (pure mulberry silk, banarasi handloom, organza, chanderi) and can share fabric swatch videos upon request.

title: How to Send Measurements to a Fashion Designer Online (Step-by-Step)

primaryKeyword: how to send measurements to a fashion designer online
excerpt: Accurate measurements are the foundation of a well-fitting custom outfit. You can take them at home with a soft measuring tape and a little help.

content.text: Accurate measurements are the foundation of a regal, flattering custom outfit. Here is a foolproof guide to measuring yourself at home.

items: Bust / Chest: Around the fullest part, tape parallel to the floor.
Waist: Around the narrowest part of your natural torso.
Hips: Around the widest circumference of your lower hips.
Shoulder width: From bone to bone across the back.
Sleeve length: From outer shoulder bone to preferred wrist/elbow length.
Garment length: From high shoulder point straight down to desired hemline.

content.title: Measurement Golden Rules
items: Keep the measuring tape snug, but never tight.
Wear the innerwear or shapewear you plan to wear with the final outfit.
Stand relaxed; do not suck in your stomach or hold your breath.
